subject: S3 + pgvector partner pilot onboarding — technical sync & next steps
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Peter Nolan <peter@pinecone.io>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@vectorcraft.consulting>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: S3 + pgvector partner pilot onboarding — technical sync & next steps

Hi Peter / Alicia —

Thanks again for committing to the joint pilot with VectorWorks. As discussed in last week's call, we want to validate two things in the first sprint: (1) an S3-backed coldstore for raw embeddings and (2) a pgvector index tier for low-latency nearest-neighbor retrieval.

To keep the pilot lean, proposed scope for Sprint 0 (2 weeks):
- Confirm S3 bucket layout and lifecycle (raw embeddings, compressed shards, manifests)
- Agree on pgvector table schema and sharding approach for ~50M vectors
- Define read/write paths: ingestion -> S3 raw -> background ingestion into pgvector; fallback to S3 for cold reads
- Ops/observability checklist: metrics (ingest qps, query latency p95), S3 egress cost estimate, and failover plan

Attachments: S3_pgvector_integration_notes.pdf (initial spec), partner-mop-draft.docx (MOP template)

As next steps could we:
1) Get a Pinecone contact for schema recommendations (Peter?)
2) Have VectorCraft confirm operational constraints (Alicia?)
3) Internal owners: Camila to own pilot rollout, Marcus to own perf testing, Laura to handle contracting/SLA details

I propose a kickoff on Mon 2 Mar 2026 at 14:00 ET. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Peter Nolan <peter@pinecone.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@vectorcraft.consulting>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: S3 + pgvector partner pilot onboarding — technical sync & next steps

Thanks Sean —

This looks good. A couple quick notes from Pinecone's side:
- For a pgvector-like table we recommend storing 128-bit float quantized vectors for cost savings; we can provide a connector pattern we used for S3-hydration into our ingestion pipeline.
- Need to confirm indexing time for 50M vectors; expect ~12-18 hours depending on instance types. We'll draft a sizing doc.
- For failover, exposing a consistent API layer that routes to pgvector or S3 (with a slightly higher latency) is straightforward. We can provide sample router code.

I'll loop in our solutions engineer on sizing docs after this note. Kickoff time on 2 Mar 14:00 ET works from our side.

Best,
Peter Nolan
Partnerships | Pinecone

Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: S3 + pgvector partner pilot onboarding — technical sync & next steps

Quick internal note before kickoff:
- Marcus: can you prepare a lightweight perf harness (k=10, batch sizes 8/32) that we can run against a small slice (1M vectors) to baseline p50/p95? If possible, include an S3-only cold-read path so we have a clearly measurable delta.
- Laura: can you draft the basic MOP and a short list of non-negotiable SLAs (query p95, data retention, retention notification window) so we can share with VectorWorks legal?
- Sean: please add a short entry in the kickoff agenda for integration test cases and expected success criteria.

I'll update the spec with Camila's notes and upload to the Drive link.

Thanks,
Camila
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@vectorcraft.consulting>
To: Peter Nolan <peter@pinecone.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, VectorWorks Pilot <pilot-admin@vectorworks.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: S3 + pgvector partner pilot onboarding — technical sync & next steps

Thanks all — kickoff went well. A few action items from VectorCraft's side:
- We'll supply a small ingestion script to convert existing embeddings into the recommended quantized format (target 256 dims -> 128-bit quantized).
- We'll validate S3 lifecycle transitions and propose a TTL for cold shards (default 90 days).
- Expect to deliver the ingestion script and a short runbook by Wed 4 Mar.

A note on costing: VectorWorks asked for a rough egress estimate; Marcus, can you prepare a conservative S3 egress/cost delta for a 6-week pilot?

-Alicia
Principal Consultant | VectorCraft
